lead: What if every space agency in the world worked as one team? This page shows how much faster and cheaper space could be.
try: Press Voyager 2 and switch on more agencies one by one. Watch the hours when nobody can hear the spacecraft disappear.
points: One country's radio dishes lose a far-away spacecraft for part of every day as Earth turns. Dishes from many countries together never lose it.
A phone that listens to every country's navigation satellites sees many more of them, so it finds you faster and more accurately.
Today two separate Moon bases are being planned, and much of their hardware is being built twice. Sharing it would save years.
